title: Consistent Instance Field for Dynamic Scene Understanding
summary: Consistent Instance Field represents a dynamic scene as a continuous probabilistic field with separate occupancy probability and conditional instance distribution at each space-time point.

mechanisms.name: Occupancy plus conditional instance field
mechanisms.description: Factor physical occupancy from conditional instance identity so persistence and identity uncertainty can evolve separately across viewpoint, deformation, and occlusion.
mechanisms.limitations: Novel-view panoptic segmentation and 4D querying do not establish online wearable occupancy, DTR lineage authority, motion-branch correctness, collision risk, real-time phone execution, user benefit, or safety.
